question: Which Indian cricketer became only the second wicketkeeper in Test history to score centuries in both innings during the first Test against England at Headingley in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rishabh Pant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rishabh Pant** etched his name in cricket history during the **first Test** against **England** at **Headingley** in **June 2025** by scoring centuries in both innings of the match.
 
• By achieving this feat, he became only the **second wicketkeeper** in the entire history of **Test cricket** to record twin centuries in a single match.
 
• The first wicketkeeper to accomplish this rare milestone was **Andy Flower** of **Zimbabwe**, who scored **142** and **199 not out** against **South Africa** in the **year 2001**.
 
• Pant's aggressive batting style and ability to counter-attack were on full display at the **Leeds** venue, helping **India** secure a dominant position in the opening game of the series.
 
• This achievement further solidifies his reputation as one of the greatest match-winners
